name: davi-route
description: EXPERIMENTAL routing hooks for measuring a verifier inside Claude Code. A: after an Agent (subagent) call, a verifier scores the result and, below a threshold, asks for a re-run with the strong model. E: before an Agent call, sets the subagent model (cheap first; the strong model after an escalation). B: at Stop, a verifier checks completion and can block the stop once. All off by default and fail-open. Load with --plugin-dir from an EVAL.Davi checkout.

route_enabled.title: A + E: subagent routing
route_enabled.description: Verify Agent results (PostToolUse) and set the subagent model (PreToolUse).

route_cheap_model.title: Cheap subagent model
route_cheap_model.description: Model string for the first attempt (e.g. haiku).

route_strong_model.title: Strong subagent model
route_strong_model.description: Model string after an escalation (e.g. opus).

route_pin_cheap.title: Pin the cheap model
route_pin_cheap.description: always | if_unset | off: when to set the cheap model on an Agent call without a pending escalation.

stop_verify_enabled.title: B: completion check at Stop
stop_verify_enabled.description: Verify completion when the agent stops; block once below the threshold.

log_file.title: Log file (JSONL)
log_file.description: One line per hook call: probabilities, decisions, models, latency, estimated judge cost. No text.

anthropic_api_key.title: Anthropic API key (claude judge)
anthropic_api_key.description: Used only by the claude judge.
